name: Cardiovascular and Respiratory Systems
description: Heart anatomy, circulation, blood and breathing.

content.answer: Right atrium, right ventricle, left atrium, left ventricle

cards.prompt: Path of blood through the heart (starting at the right atrium)

content.answer: Right atrium → tricuspid valve → right ventricle → pulmonary valve → lungs → left atrium → mitral valve → left ventricle → aortic valve → aorta.

cards.sourceRef: Guyton & Hall, Textbook of Medical Physiology (Elsevier); Gray's Anatomy for Students

content.answer: Tricuspid valve
